resources.string: How much you can still spend, and until when.
What is left, at a glance
Each cap says what you can still spend on one thing, and until when. A spend is two touches and the amount.
What a period leaves over goes to a reserve. An overspend the reserve cannot cover is forgiven when the period ends.
No account, no ads, no internet permission at all: Tetto sends nothing.
What do you want to put a cap on?
Pick yours. Any other can be added later, from the caps screen.
What you allow yourself, and for how long: a cap starts again when its period ends. You can change them later.
